The horse has a long narrow head dipping diagonally DOWN-LEFT, its muzzle near the lower-left quadrant, its neck descending on the RIGHT; its SILVER-GRAY mane lies along the upper-left/back edge of its head and near the upper-right ear. Keep these precise shapes and positions unchanged.
ONLY recolor existing pixels of the horse: the current rust-orange/brown coat becomes a deeper crimson red, the existing silver-gray mane becomes GOLDEN YELLOW with corresponding dark ochre shadows and pale yellow highlights, and the tiny existing eye may become yellow WITHOUT enlarging or moving it. Preserve the current warm beige background, gold square frame, outer green gradient pixels, black shadow contours, and original pixel-art shading EXACTLY. Do not shift, rotate, crop, zoom, widen, redesign or redraw the horse. Do not add fire, text, paper, new bridle details, extra mane, new eyes, eyelashes, gradients, smooth painting, highlights, outlines, or ornamental details. Keep the coarse 28x28 block pixel art; NO enhancement or added resolution of detail. The result must look like the very same original item icon with ONLY its horse palette swapped. Return a single full square image with all original margins. Preserve the exact reference composition above all else.

Keep the map silhouette at left, the entire small English description paragraph beneath the heading, both characters at lower left, the DEICIDE logo at lower right, the decorative lower strip, solid black background, margins and every layout position unchanged. title: Use case: text-localization. Asset type: transparent fantasy MMORPG map-name title overlay. The supplied image is a white-letter alpha title (white lettering on transparency; do not mistake its white preview for a blank image). Replace the old map-name lettering with the exact English text 'Forgotten Taros', in refined old fantasy calligraphic serif lettering similar to the supplied game title. Pure white letter strokes with subtle soft white edging, fully transparent background, no solid white rectangle. One centered horizontal line with generous transparent outer margins. Do not include Korean text, labels, logos, frames, icons, scenery, checkerboard pattern or any other text. Return RGBA with real transparent alpha.
